About Me

A CSE student learning by building

I'm Niloy Kumar Kundu Sompod, currently pursuing my B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering at Lovely Professional University, Punjab. Over my previous semesters I built a foundation in DBMS with SQL, Python, C++, HTML and CSS, and I'm now working through Data Structures & Algorithms to sharpen how I think about problems.

Outside the classroom, I've taken part in a hackathon, earned a leadership certificate, and completed Infosys's Cyber Security course — a mix of technical and collaborative experience I bring into every project.

I like turning ideas into working websites: from a full quiz application to business-category sites for real use cases.
